newsitem.title: POLAND: Bank Handlowy rates Krosno buy.
newsitem.headline: Bank Handlowy rates Krosno buy.

text.p: The brokerage of Poland's Bank Handlowy SA gave glass maker Krosno SA a buy recommendation due to its diversified production and strong position on the industrial glass market, the brokerage said in a report.
The report, dated August 2 but made available to the press only on Monday, also noted Krono's glass fibre production, high exports, expected production growth and highly trained staff.
"The company has a strong position on the domestic market of hand and automatically moulded glass," the report said.
On the downside, the Handlowy noted growing competition on the domestic market, Krosno's high but necessary investment until the year 2000, strong trade unions and weak marketing.
Handlowy predicted that Krosno would have a 11.5 million zloty net profit this year and 15 million in 1997 against 8.4 million last year and 3.4 million in 1994.
They expect Krosno's sales this year to rise to 195 million zlotys and 233 million in 1997 against 154 million last year.
On August 2 Krosno shares traded at 45 zlotys before rising to 55 zlotys at Monday's close.
